name: theme
body: A theme: a project-defined (one directory per theme under the resolved library's `themes/<name>/`) named set of CSS variable tokens (colours, fonts, spacing) in `theme.css`, plus files it owns (fonts, logos) in its directory. A theme's CSS — and every CSS it `@import`s, wherever that CSS lives (its own directory, another theme, or `media/`) — may reference any servable file in the library with both `url()` and `@import`: a relative path from its own location, the reserved `media:` prefix into the library's shared `media/` tree, or the reserved `theme:<name>/` prefix into another theme's files (theme-media-references). Every reference is validated at load time and rewritten to the served URL at serve time, so several themes share one copy of structure, `@font-face` rules and brand media, and a theme can build on another. Themes come solely from the resolved library (global.constraint.no-embedded-template-assets); deck-wide; omitted selection resolves to the project's `default`.
